_comment: Arms the mob on spawn, then requires it to still be holding a focus to cast. equipment is applied once per mob on the reconcile pass, not every tick, and is remembered so a reload does not re-roll the gear.

equipment._comment: Each hand takes a weighted list. An entry may be a bare item id (weight 1) or an object with item and weight. chance is the odds of equipping at all; only_if_empty leaves a hand alone when the mob already holds something.

spells._comment: require_held_item makes the spell conditional on required_items being in the hand named by required_hand. The list accepts item ids and #tags.
No item gate, so an unarmed skeleton still has something to do.
